review.assessment: The diff introduces a new `solution.sh` that pipes stdin through `grep -v '^#'`. This strips lines starting with `#` at column one but completely ignores indented comments and blank/whitespace-only lines, falling short of the task scope. While inline comment preservation accidentally works due to the anchored regex, the script does not fulfill the stated requirements for indentation or emptiness.

findings.defect: Fails to remove comment lines where '#' is not at the first column.
Fails to strip blank or whitespace-only lines.
